adjudication.rationale: Diff shows Admin::EmbeddingController#update simply re-renders the serialized OpenStruct (@embedding) without modifying/persisting anything (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb). On the client, admin-embedding controller defines saveChanges() that calls this.get('embedding').update({}) (app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6), which would hit PUT /admin/customize/embedding (config/routes.rb) and appear to “save” while doing nothing. This is a concrete, diff-grounded completeness/behavior concern (misleading no-op endpoint/action), and there are no functional tests covering update semantics (only subclass checks).
